title: ci(fleet-patrols): prose and comments stop naming the four retired patrol workflow files
body:
Fixes #26525
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:12 个文件里仍点名四个已退役巡检 workflow 文件(`required-set-patrol.yml` 等)的注释与说明文字,全部改指 `fleet-patrols.yml` 及对应 job 名;只改注释,零行为变化。
- 为什么改:这四个巡检已并入 `fleet-patrols.yml`,读这些注释的开发者/席位会去找一个已不存在的文件;`lint.yml` 里「watchdog 的 PR 过滤只点名它自己」与 `fleet-patrols.yml` 头部「cron 单边改动哪儿都不红」两句也已失真。
- 风险与回滚:风险极低,纯注释;每处替换都保持行数不变(有自测按行号钉住声明行)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/lint.yml`(watchdog 静态钉说明块,约 L2541–L2558,改写了 ALONE 一句)、`.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml`(L25 cron 句)、`scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs`(L458–L461 复用 job id 的举例重新实测)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -E 'required-set-patrol\.yml|platform-checklist-watchdog\.yml|release-coverage-patrol\.yml|board-snapshot\.yml' -- . ':!ui' ':!docs/audits'`,预期只剩 `fleet-patrols.yml` 自己的历史说明 8 行。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 触及 `.github/workflows/**`(Tier H),请审批或亲手入队。

## What changes

Comments and prose only; every hunk is line-neutral (`git diff --numstat` is N/N on all 12 files) because `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` pins live declaration line numbers (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:738`) and `packages/spec/scripts/dist-freshness.test.ts` cites `scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs:250`.

Each re-pointed claim was checked against `fleet-patrols.yml` at this head: the `required-set-patrol` job branches on `exit_code == '0'` / `!= '0'` (L348, L362) and runs `--verify-required-set` behind a continuation and a redirection (L309–310); the `release-coverage-patrol` job runs `check-release-section-coverage.mjs` bare (L922) and `--strict` (L938); the `board-snapshot` job installs no pnpm (its "No `pnpm install`" note); the patrol-posture words live at L149.

## Tests

Final head `5fe8c76d`, after merging `origin/main`.

- Acceptance grep: only `fleet-patrols.yml`'s own history note (L12–15 table, four "formerly" headers) plus the out-of-card hits below remain.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier): `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1935 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred.` (419.1s). An earlier head of this branch read `✗ 1 of 1935 case(s) failed` on the census line pin, fixed by keeping the hunks line-neutral.
- `bash scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.selftest.sh`: exit 0, `5 cases, 27 checks`.
- `node scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (60 assertions); `node scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (75 cases).
- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 76 commands): 73 run with exit 0, 4 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt workspace packages — `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`; none reads a comment this PR edits, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs all four on a built tree). `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 77 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`

## Acceptance notes

- Out of this card, not edited (listed for the seat to route): `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md:301` (a dated audit record), and the ui lane's tree: `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md:47` and `:2684`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts:324`, `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs:236`.
- Beyond the claim's file list, two lines in `.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml` were edited: L760 (a stale `required-set-patrol.yml` mention outside the history note, which the card's own acceptance grep requires gone) and L25 (the one-sided-cron sentence the card's scope addendum 6440937713 assigned to this sweep, false since #26653 landed at `86ae47e1`).
- `scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs` L466 still says "28 files, 51 jobs"; there are 30 workflow files today. That count was not re-measured here (not a retired-name mention); noted, not touched.
- An earlier commit on this branch added a line above `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`'s `inherited-population` marker and the fast tier went red on the census pin (`dispatch-gates.mjs:739` read against `:738` pinned); the later commits make every hunk line-neutral, which is what this head carries.
